Question: Payment trigger and contract
Fields: Counterparty, country, category, event basis, fee schedule, acceptance definition, payout split, reversal rules, renewal/service rights and attribution window
Evidence: Signed agreement and anonymised invoice examples

Question: Actual operating scope
Fields: Live vs waitlist, supported country, local intermediary, insurer, category, accepted value range, required ownership/valuation documents
Evidence: Category-country availability matrix and acceptance record
Parameters: Whether a modeled revenue stream is available

Question: Acquisition denominator and cost
Fields: Channel spend, attributable labour, partner fees, unique acquired owners, acquisition date, country, category and referral source
Evidence: Monthly channel exports, invoices and owner-level acquisition keys
Parameters: CAC; avoid using CAC per paid lead with q a second time

Question: First payment funnel
Fields: Unique eligible owners, qualified requests, submission, acceptance/rejection reason, policy binding if relevant, dates and paid amount
Evidence: Owner/event-level anonymised funnel for all available history, ideally 12-24 months
Parameters: p, alpha, q and paid-event delay

Question: Variable cost and servicing
Fields: AI/OCR calls, images/items, licensed-data charges, storage, payment/platform fees, support/expert minutes and wage rates, per policy costs
Evidence: Usage invoices, operational time samples and allocation rules
Parameters: h, vE, vM, vS, vPolicy; costs of free users

Question: Invoices and collections
Fields: Event ID, invoice date/amount, credits, due date, actual receipts, writeoffs, insurer share and currency
Evidence: Anonymised receivables and receipts ledger tied to event IDs
Parameters: Net fees, cash lag, bad debt and working capital

Question: Continuation before and after payment
Fields: Cohort, first payment date, eligible state, post-payment state, meaningful task timestamps, deletion/contactability and exposure months
Evidence: Anonymised monthly owner/event panel with observation end
Parameters: rhoE/rhoM with censoring; app visit frequency measured separately

Question: Genuine repeat eligibility
Fields: New asset/contract episode, relationship to first lead, consent, duplicate disposition, incremental accepted fee and date
Evidence: Repeat-event ledger plus explicit contract clause
Parameters: lambda; never infer from scans or portfolio additions

Question: Renewals and revenue rights
Fields: Policy births, term, premium, cancellation, renewal due/observed dates, surviving policies, actual renewal fees, service costs and ownership of book
Evidence: Mature policy cohorts and counterparty renewal statements
Parameters: Policy survival and phiRenewal; young cohorts are censored

Question: Collector fit and willingness to pay
Fields: Category, owner vs dealer, collection-value bands, items, changes per month, existing tools, insured status, locale and completed protection need
Evidence: Consented targeted interviews plus paid pilot outcomes
Parameters: Insurable fraction, q by segment, substitution and differentiation

Question: Paid tools and service referrals
Fields: Offer exposure, actual payer, starts, billed renewal, cancellations/refunds, net recurring price, app-store/payment costs, completed referral fee
Evidence: Paid pilot or existing billing ledger; signed service terms
Parameters: kappa, eta, b-vS and event-level referral margin

Question: Operating scale and concentration
Fields: Actual fixed spend, incremental build/licence/integration cost, channel capacity, signed distribution reach, insurer concentration and currencies
Evidence: Management accounts, pipeline and partner channel history
Parameters: Company profit, startup funding, concentration and obtainable volume
